cases.input: Normalize an already-downloaded two-page report into source context while preserving page locators, source URL, retrieved time and exact text segments.
requiredBehaviors: preserve stable source identity and page locators
create deterministic segment identities and ordering
compute digests over the normalized text without creating research claims
forbiddenBehaviors: summarize or paraphrase source text as if it were original
treat the source URL as proof of authority
skillAnchors: Originale Seiten-, Abschnitts-, Absatz-, Tabellen-, Block- oder Datensatzgrenzen

cases.input: Normalize OCR output where page 3 is partially unreadable, the input was truncated after page 5 and the document metadata may be stale.
requiredBehaviors: mark the affected segment partial or unreadable
record known extraction gaps and lossy normalization
set truncation and stale state explicitly without inventing missing text
forbiddenBehaviors: hide truncation or stale metadata from downstream research

cases.input: A context draft translates a German source into English, fills a missing table cell from surrounding context, merges all pages into one segment and labels the publisher authoritative.
requiredBehaviors: reject destruction of source locators and authority inference
forbiddenBehaviors: emit translated text as the original source
infer missing source content or credibility
skillAnchors: Nicht zulässig sind stilles Paraphrasieren, Zusammenfassen, Übersetzen
keine fehlenden Zeichen, Wörter, Tabellenzellen oder Abschnitte erfinden
